Summary: Refund window is 14 days in the PRD and 30 in the ticket
What each says: PRD: "within 14 days of purchase". Ticket: "within 30 days".
Assumption if unresolved: Test against 14 days (PRD wins until told otherwise)

What each says: "The refund is processed quickly". No time, and "processed" could mean requested, approved or paid out.
Assumption if unresolved: Treat as: status becomes Approved within 1 working day

Summary: Who approves a refund and can it be refused?
What each says: Nothing says whether refunds are automatic or reviewed. No rule for a learner who already finished the course.
Ticket: "authorised administrators". PRD: "Only an Owner can invite instructors".

Summary: "The invitation link expires" with no duration
What each says: No lifetime and no way to age a link in the test environment.
Assumption if unresolved: Assume 7 days; ask for a test endpoint to age a link

Summary: Invitation to an email that already has an account
What each says: Not covered: existing learner account; invite after cancel; resend after expiry.
Assumption if unresolved: Show a clear message and create no duplicate

Summary: Which time zone do discount codes end in?
What each says: PRD: "end of the campaign". Ticket: "end date". No zone, and not stated whether the end date is inclusive.
Assumption if unresolved: End of day in the company time zone

Summary: Import needs a job queue the codebase does not have
What each says: Ticket depends on "the job queue". The repository has no queue library and the deployment notes say the API has no worker.
Assumption if unresolved: Cannot test background behaviour until it exists

Summary: Import limit: 5000 students in the PRD but the ticket gives none
What each says: PRD: "up to 5,000". Ticket: no limit, no file size, no row rules (duplicates, missing email).

Summary: "Uploaded files are handled safely" has no criteria
What each says: Formula injection, macro files, malformed CSV, who can download the stored file: none stated.
Assumption if unresolved: Use the imports checklist as the criteria

Summary: Import screen ticket has no design
What each says: Design field is blank, yet the ticket says states "must match the design".
Assumption if unresolved: Cannot test the screen until a design exists

Summary: Certificates are audited but nothing stores an audit record
What each says: Ticket requires an audit entry. The only audit code writes to the log; nothing is stored or queryable.

Summary: Certificate for a learner who is refunded after completing
What each says: No rule: is the certificate withdrawn, kept, or marked?

Summary: Admin sees who switched notifications off: personal data rule
What each says: No statement of which roles may see this, or whether learners are told.
